Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

On this week's Jeopardy, the first contestant was a receptionist, the second contestant was a physician, and the third contestant's profession wasn't revealed. The physician quickly outpaced both of the other contestants, and the receptionist did the worst, only getting two questions right. Who won Jeopardy?
A. The physician
B. Can't be determined
C. The receptionist
